reviews.text: Lulu pup shop is a great place to visit lots of hats just a great inventory. And the owners were very nice
Lula Pup Shop is a great spot my dog loves their treats and the bandanas are really good too
Very impressed with the friendly staff and excellent product range. My pet loves the toys I bought here.

Had a great experience here! Definitely a hidden gem for any pet lover. Lula’s Pup Shop is family owned and the owners were super helpful helping me out on making Rudi’s custom necklace! Thank you so much for the great customer service and attention to detail! Highly recommend stopping by and supporting these amazing ladies and their awesome shop :)
The sweetest people you will ever meet! Family owned business and the owner was able to switch out the metal for me on the dog collar I bought. The prices are good I will definitely be coming back!

Dog absolutely LOVES this shop! He’s usually pretty introverted, but he feels completely comfortable here which says so much about the atmosphere and the wonderful people who run it. The variety of specialty treats is amazing, and he loves getting to pick his favorites every time we visit. Everything is handmade and family-operated, which makes the whole experience feel extra special and personal. You can really tell how much care and love goes into everything they do. Super cute place!

Lula Pup Shop is such a gem! The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly love animals. They carry the best selection of quality treats, toys, and accessories—you won’t find a better local spot for your pup! 🐾 …
Very cute accessories for dogs and treats too!
Always a great experience here, lovely selection and even better staff. Always go for the topper for food the pupps love it! Great selection of toys and shirts!! Will be back as always. (:
This is my baby’s favorite store! We love their treats. Ro (the owner) makes her own bandanas, collars, and leashes, too! The cross-body leash is a life changer!!!
Great swag for dog parents, love that most of the products here were handcrafted by Ro herself! Lots of options for treats and dog accessories! Great small business to support!
Had a great experience at Lula Pup Shop. They were so helpful and nice. We designed a necklace collar for our dog. She’s constantly being mistaken for a male dog. It came out great.
Just bought one of their dog collars at the Denton Market and loved it! Our corgi fits in M and L collars.

My pup and I love this shop. There are so many amazing things for pets and pet parents. From the treats to the toys and homemade collars, Bandanas and shirts. To pet Jewelry this place has it ALL bring your pets and come support this small business. Ro and Alicia care about all their visitors and it shows to how much they work hard and hear out all their customers!!! Definitely earned a long time support my boy Hiro loves it here.
Bought the cutest “Meody” shirt at their farmers market location last week. Definitely won’t be our last purchase. Love all their stuff!

Roe was absolutely the sweetest! We loved a print on a t shirt that she didn’t have in our size. She came up with a solution and printed it immediately. Thank you so very much! Also absolutely love that her parents help her with her small business! They all seem the nicest! My kitties are happy campers.  My dog loved his treat! But more importantly I loved my shirt 🤣 Will definitely be back!
My dog and I love this store, the owner is so sweet and always gives treats to my baby. She also has the best toys, Mochi is the biggest fan 😊 …
They have some cute stuff but we bought both of these today and they were both trash in literally the first 2 minutes.
I'm so happy when this place opened up.  Ro and alicia are the sweetest people. And the love for work shows in their smile.  Luna tugs me to the shop every weekend.
